sample.question: A media company wants to build generative AI applications on AWS without managing servers, using a pay-per-use model and a unified API across foundation models. Which service should they choose?
sample.explanation: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed service for building GenAI applications with foundation models through unified APIs, without provisioning servers.

sample.question: An enterprise needs API access to many foundation models and wants a private copy it can fine-tune with proprietary data, without that data being used to train the base model. Which capability addresses this?
sample.explanation: Bedrock provides access to foundation models and can create a customer-specific copy for fine-tuning so customer data is not used to train the base FM.

sample.question: A bank wants to adapt a foundation model using labeled internal examples so model weights change for its domain. Training data will be stored in Amazon S3. Which approach should they use?

options.A: Fine-tune a foundation model in Amazon Bedrock
options.B: Enable Amazon Macie on the S3 bucket

sample.explanation: Fine-tuning adapts a copy of a foundation model with your data and updates weights; Bedrock expects training data in a required format in Amazon S3.
